what: A game process of a long training run aborted on a damaged heap while the search freed the nodes of a game's tree that it did not keep; two games of that process had failed the engine's state check just before; the run replaced the process and lost only that process's games.

run.engine_and_search_sources_same_as: 999c90c (no change under src/, include/ or setup.py)
run.initial_models: generation 13 of the run of 19 November (commit 999c90c)
run.game_slots_of_a_process: group g plays slots 42g to 42g+41 (_GameProcess.group in studies/campaign/shared_evaluator.py); the six processes were started in group order, PIDs 7796 to 7801

failed_games_before_crash.failure: RuntimeError: A zone number names no zone
RuntimeError: A zone number names no zone

failed_games_order_note: manifest.json lists failed games in the order the training process read them; both state-check failures come before the 42 games lost with the process, and batch index 3 runs from network update 3 (10:08:12) to update 4 (11:32:04), so both happened in process 7800 between 10:08:12 and 10:46:18

state_check.runs: after every move, through RecordedHistory::validate in src/campaign_runtime.cpp
